description: This file implements a linter for validating comments and types in Kubernetes code generation, including rules application, error collection, and recursive type linting.

classes.name: linter
classes.description: Struct holding the state of the linting process, including maps of linted types, rules, and errors.

methods.name: AddError
methods.description: Adds a linting error for a specific type and field.

methods.name: newLinter
methods.description: Creates a new linter instance with specified rules.

methods.name: lintType
methods.description: Recursively lints a type and its members, applying rules and handling different type kinds.

methods.name: lintComments
methods.description: Runs all registered rules on a set of comments, extracting tags and collecting errors.
